affiliations.role_title: Mandarin-language trainee at the University of Chicago
affiliations.research_notes: The obituary gives a sequential Army-language-training-to-OSS narrative, but the personnel file has not yet been reviewed to confirm exact transfer dates.
Student status is not treated as employment. The accessible source does not provide an exact graduation date.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Mort S. Bobrow is strongly matched to the Mort S. Bobrow described as an Army Mandarin trainee later sent by OSS to China.
claims.evidence_excerpt: part of his role was outlined in the book, OSS in China
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official index supplies the exact uncommon name and an OSS personnel-file pointer; the obituary independently describes OSS service in China.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact uncommon full name including middle initial, plus independent OSS-China service context.
claims.temporal_assessment: The obituary describes wartime service but does not supply exact transfer dates.
claims.match_notes: The match is strong but remains below confirmed until the indexed personnel file or a service-number-bearing record is reviewed.

claims.claim_text: Available evidence indicates that Bobrow’s immediate pre-OSS affiliation was the U.S. Army, which sent him to Mandarin-language training at the University of Chicago.
claims.evidence_excerpt: joined the US Army where he was sent to the University of Chicago to study Mandarin Chinese
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The obituary places Army-sponsored Mandarin training immediately before describing his selection for an OSS mission to China.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match to the uncommon indexed full name and documented OSS-China service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded sequential narrative; exact transfer dates remain unverified.
claims.match_notes: Published with visible qualification. The Army is an immediate military affiliation, not a civilian employer; University of Chicago is identified as the training site.

claims.claim_text: Before entering the Army, Bobrow was a student at the University of Washington.
claims.evidence_excerpt: graduated from the University of Washington during WWII years and joined the US Army
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The obituary places University of Washington study before Army service and the later OSS mission.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match to the uncommon indexed full name and documented OSS-China service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented before Army and OSS service, but the exact graduation year is not supplied.
claims.match_notes: University attendance is recorded as student status and is not classified as employment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact uncommon full name including middle initial in the official NARA index, corroborated by an obituary describing OSS service in China.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed Box 63 personnel file and official military records to confirm transfer dates and identify any last civilian employer before Army service.
